tagline.en: Show Lab's MIT-licensed unified multimodal model — here running text-to-image generation.
tagline.zh: Show Lab 的 MIT 许可统一多模态模型——此处用于文生图生成。

en: Show-o is a unified multimodal model from Show Lab that brings understanding and generation into a single transformer. It's released under the MIT license, and its broader design spans several multimodal tasks.

In WorldFoundry the current wrapper focuses on the text-to-image path: give it a prompt and it generates an image. The runtime source is vendored in-tree; other modes such as multimodal understanding, inpainting, and extrapolation are not wired up in this integration yet.
In WorldFoundry you run the text-to-image route with a prompt to generate an image.
zh: Show-o 是 Show Lab 推出的统一多模态模型，把理解与生成整合进单一 transformer。它以 MIT 许可发布，整体设计覆盖多种多模态任务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，当前封装聚焦于文生图路径：给它一段提示词，它就生成一张图片。运行时源码已内置于代码库；多模态理解、inpainting、外扩等其他模式在本次集成中尚未接入。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用一段提示词运行文生图路径即可生成图片。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want text-to-image generation from an openly-licensed unified multimodal model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可的统一多模态模型做文生图时使用。

notFor.en: In this integration only text-to-image is available — multimodal understanding, inpainting, and extrapolation are not wired up yet, so don't rely on those modes here.
notFor.zh: 在本次集成中仅提供文生图——多模态理解、inpainting 与外扩尚未接入，请勿在此依赖这些模式。

en: Unified multimodal model from Show Lab
zh: 出自 Show Lab 的统一多模态模型
在 WorldFoundry 中提供文生图
运行时源码内置于代码库
